title: Re-read of preregistration 0018's banked artifact under its own clauses with the reader's one wrong literal corrected: the sealed hash of the null control's row block is the first 20000 pool rows the runner fitted (822b6102...), not 0017's fold-based block (0653cc12...) that 0018 restated by mistake. No new measurement. Every 0018 number was known when this was written and is quoted here; under these clauses they read OOB_TRANSFER_FAILS.

scope.one_line: Same corpus, same seed, same sealed pool and evaluation set, same extension corpus, same artifact (artifacts/pivot/oob_4096.json and oob_4096_scores.json as committed at 4dcc2b6), same three recipes, same clause, same bar, same tolerances, same flags as 0018. Nothing is fitted and nothing is scored; the reader reads what 0018 banked.
scope.why_this_exists: 0018's frozen reader emitted VOID with five clauses named, all of them one hash: partition.null_sorted_sha256='822b61020d276a04620440eb2d2e7e60376e1efba83e89607c33c09c39fa1425' against the preregistered '0653cc12293ae078dd68b900c8778d93e701261ca93414be9eb7bb8e7ee686db', and the null fit's fingerprint, ledger events and 'fitted on the sealed rows' clause that derive from it. The runner fitted the null control on the block 0018's design names (scope.design: 'M4 on the first 20000 pool rows with shuffled labels'; arms[0]; tools/pivot/run_oob.py: nn = min(len(tr), int(P['null_rows'])); null_rows = tr[:nn], with tr the sealed pool in its sealed order and null_rows 20000), which is the block 0014 fitted (artifacts/pivot/recipe_search_4096.json null_control.fit_rows_sorted_sha256) and 0016 sealed (prereg/0016-fdc-4096.json sealed_partition.null.sorted_sha256: 'the first 20000 pool rows'). 0018's scope.partition_sealed_before_any_fit restated the null block 'hash for hash from 0017', and 0017's null block, like 0015's, is the first 20000 training rows of the first leave-one-family-out fold (tools/pivot/run_lofo_l3.py: null_rows = folds[families[0]][:nn]). 0018's reader stops recomputing after a fit clause fails, so its readings, reproduction, null-tolerance and transfer clauses were never reached; its scope, corpus, extension-corpus, partition, environment, order and every other sealed-hash clause passed on the artifact. The re-read reader evaluates them all. The defect, the pre-freeze check that compared the reader to the preregistration and never to the runner's block, and the gate that built its control from the reader's literals are filed in CORRECTIONS.md (2026-09-10). A re-run under a corrected preregistration was the alternative and was not taken: the run reproduced 0014's three references exactly and the seeds are fixed, so a re-run would give the numbers already disclosed here and would be no blinder; it would cost 21995.4 s of fit and four more scorings of the sealed evaluation set for a reading the banked artifact already carries. 0013 set the precedent for a re-read with the numbers disclosed.

what_changes_from_0018.summary: One literal in the reader (PARTITION['null_sorted_sha256']), plus the output path (oob_4096_reread_verdict.json), the preregistration stamp the verdict carries (preregistration 0019-oob-4096-reread with reads_artifact_of 0018-oob-4096; the artifact it reads is still required to be stamped 0018-oob-4096), the verdict schema name, the 'READER 0019' print prefix, the headline print line (which says it is a re-read, as 0013's does) and a docstring prefix. The substitutions are applied in the order listed, each to the text the preceding ones produced, and each occurrences count is the count at that point: 'READER 0018' occurs 6 times in the frozen file, the headline print line takes one and the generic substitution the remaining 5. Every constant, hash, clause, tolerance, flag and recomputation is 0018's reader verbatim: the reader file is 0018's frozen file (sha256 47a3f6544f3d623c54c4c5ed8b23da5b182d37e864e9789e052ccb2b1ffd2598) with exactly the substitutions below applied, and the oob4096 mutation gate rebuilds that text from 0018's file and these substitutions and fails if the re-read reader differs by any other line.

declared_substitutions.new:
"""Frozen reader for preregistration 0019 — a RE-READ of 0018's banked artifact under 0018's own clauses with the
reader's one wrong literal corrected: the sealed hash of the null control's row block.

WHAT HAPPENED. 0018's frozen reader (tools/readers/oob4096_verdict.py, sealed in chain entry 18) emitted VOID on an
honest, complete run for a reason that lies in one sealed literal, not in the run: the preregistration's sealed_partition
restated the null block hash for hash from 0017, and 0017's null block (like 0015's) is the first 20000 rows of the first
leave-one-family-out fold's training set (0653cc12...), while 0018's design text, its arms and its runner
(tools/pivot/run_oob.py: nn = min(len(tr), int(P["null_rows"])); null_rows = tr[:nn], with tr the sealed pool in its
sealed order) use the first 20000 pool rows (822b6102...), the block 0014 fitted and 0016 sealed. The runner fitted the
null control on the block the design names; the reader compared its hash, and the fingerprint derived from it, against
the wrong literal. Five validity clauses failed, all of them that one hash. 0018's reader stops recomputing after a fit
clause fails, so its readings, reproduction, null-tolerance and transfer clauses were never reached; its scope, corpus,
extension-corpus, partition, environment, order and every other sealed-hash clause passed. This reader evaluates them all. The 0018 pre-freeze check compared the reader's literal to the
preregistration's and never to the block the runner builds on the real pool; that is filed in CORRECTIONS.md
(2026-09-10). A frozen reader is not edited after it has seen a number, so 0018 stands VOID on the record, and this
reader re-reads the SAME banked artifact under the SAME clauses with that one literal changed.

DISCLOSED IN FULL. Every 0018 number was known when this reader and its preregistration were written: 0018's reader
printed the model's counts and the artifact's readings beside its VOID, banked every reading in its verdict file
(readings_banked), and the artifact carries them: M4's correct real-family rows 2450 of 38452 (0.0637)
against 3402 needed; the standardised logistic 2755 (0.0716) and the incumbent 2439 (0.0634) on the same rows; the
eight-family mixture 4703 of 61409 (0.0766); reproductions 0.2395, 0.2317 and 0.2884, each exactly 0014's value; the
null control 0.0371 on the extension rows and 0.0383 on the sealed rows. Under the clauses below those numbers read OOB_TRANSFER_FAILS on the one
clause, with every validity clause passing. This preregistration therefore commits, before the reader is hashed into
the chain, to the outcome the known numbers give; its only freedom would have been to change a clause, and no clause
is changed. It cannot revise 0018's VOID, 0003, 0014, 0015, 0016 or 0017, and it establishes no buyer.

Everything after this paragraph is 0018's reader verbatim except the substitutions listed in
prereg/0019-oob-4096-reread.json scope.what_changes_from_0018.declared_substitutions: the output path, the

RIVAL EXPLANATION, closed by construction: 'the successor was shaped by the numbers'. Yes, and it says so: the numbers are quoted above, the committed outcome is OOB_TRANSFER_FAILS, and the only change is a row-block hash that has no arithmetic content and that the pre-freeze check recomputes from the data.
stop_rules: If the re-read reader emits anything other than OOB_TRANSFER_FAILS on the banked artifact, that is published as emitted and a further correction is filed, because it would mean either that another reader defect exists or that the numbers quoted here were misread; in neither case is a clause changed.

0018's VOID is not revised, softened or annotated away; its verdict file stays banked as the frozen reader emitted it; and wherever 0019's verdict is stated (the VERDICT.md 'Failed, or did not reach a conclusion' row, titled '0018, re-read under 0019'; the 0018/0019 section; the README sentence; the outbound documents; DILIGENCE.md; the evidence page, where 0018 keeps a chip of its own reading VOID) the sentence that 0018's own frozen reader emitted VOID on a wrong sealed literal, filed in CORRECTIONS.md, appears beside it.

No number from 0018 or 0019 is quoted as a pass of the bar; the readings are banked measurements, not verdicts, and OOB_TRANSFER_FAILS is published at the same size as OOB_TRANSFERS would have been, in VERDICT.md, README.md, the outbound documents, DILIGENCE.md and the evidence page, with the flags stated in advance said beside it.

This cannot revise 0003, 0014, 0015, 0016, 0017 or 0018; establishes_a_buyer is emitted False on every path, including the unexpected-shape VOID, and revises_0003_0014_0015_0016_0017 is emitted False on every read verdict; no customer, user, partner or buyer is claimed.
The artifact and scores file are the committed ones (4dcc2b6); if either is missing or altered so that a sealed hash or fingerprint no longer matches, the reader's clauses read VOID.

No sealed parameter, recipe, family list, chunk count, bar or tolerance changes; a further defect found afterwards is a further preregistration (0013's precedent), never an edit to this file or its reader after the freeze.

thesis.what_a_sealed_literal_defect_costs: One preregistration entry, one correction at full size, the disclosure above, and a pre-freeze check that recomputes the literal from data instead of copying it. What it must not cost is a quiet edit to a frozen file.
thesis.what_the_re_read_establishes: That at 4096 bytes, fitted on the builder's eight families, 0014's searched model does not identify the encoder at chance + 0.05 on the mixture over the 38452 rows of five pinned real-file families the builder never produced (2450 against 3402 needed, 0.0637 against 0.088462); that the standardised logistic (2755) and the incumbent (2439) do not either; that the observed real-family reading sits below the 0.097 to 0.118 bracket 0018's expected-outcome paragraph derived from within-builder retention and discounted; and that the reading is carried by the synthetic families (2253 of 22957, above their 2031-row flag threshold) rather than the real ones (sql and xml reach the per-family bar, no real family does; the three synthetic families, 2253 of 22957, are above their 2031-row flag threshold).
thesis.what_neither_outcome_means: Neither names a buyer. Neither revises 0003, 0014, 0015, 0016 or 0017. OOB_TRANSFER_FAILS says that this recipe, fitted on this builder, does not carry chance + 0.05 to these five real families as pinned; not that no recipe or no training corpus could.
